title: SafePro: Evaluating the Safety of Professional-Level AI Agents
reasoning: The paper presents SafePro, a benchmark for evaluating the safety and ethical alignment of AI agents in professional domains. It specifically includes data samples for 'Discrimination / bias' and benchmarks 'unethical actions' such as agents prioritizing company profits over patient well-being, using a structured 'Professional Agent Safety Policy' to assess moral and ethical violations.
